def factor_tail_asymmetry_smoothed(df):
    """Smoothed downside vs upside jump frequency asymmetry, borrowing EWM stabilization from directional movement parent."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol = ret.rolling(63, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1).shift(1)
    down_jump = ((ret < -1.5 * vol) & (vol > 0)).rolling(63, min_periods=20).sum()
    up_jump = ((ret > 1.5 * vol) & (vol > 0)).rolling(63, min_periods=20).sum()
    raw_asym = -(down_jump - up_jump) / (down_jump + up_jump + 1.0)
    smoothed = raw_asym.ewm(span=5, min_periods=1).mean()
    df_copy["factor_tail_asymmetry_smoothed"] = smoothed
    return df_copy["factor_tail_asymmetry_smoothed"]
description: Primary mechanism inherits the tail-jump asymmetry: count returns below -1.5 sigma vs above +1.5 sigma over 63 days using lagged realized volatility, then produce the bounded negative ratio to rank downside-jump-heavy names lower. Borrow one lightweight modifier from the directional movement parent: exponential smoothing with span=5 to stabilize the bounded ratio, reduce noise, and preserve the parent's strong payoff and low turnover. This targets the parent's weak IC/ICIR while keeping RankICIR and payoff evidence intact; cross-sectional transform remains none per strong raw payoff evidence.
